text:
maria: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike in timeouts + a bunch of 4xx noise in prod starting ~09:20. Alerts for gateway errors fired but lots of 429/400 spam. Where's the single dashboard people use to triage gateway timeouts + 4xx/5xx breakdowns?

aj: Grafana -> Observability -> 'gateway-errors-overview' is our go-to. direct link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/obs/gateway-errors-overview?orgId=1 

sam: +1 that dashboard. There's a panel that breaks down by status class (2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx) and another by upstream (ingress-nginx, edge-proxy, alb). Use the top-right timepicker to 15m/1h.

lucy: If you want a quick PromQL to copy into Explore: 
```
sum by (status_class) (rate(http_requests_total{env="prod",job=~"gateway.*"}[5m]))
```
That will show 4xx vs 5xx trends.

maria: Thanks — is there an existing runbook/remediation for distinguishing genuine 5xx vs client-induced 4xx floods? I want to avoid paging on 429 bursts from a misbehaving client.

aj: We have a short runbook: https://kb.redwood.com/observability/error-rate-runbook — covers excluding known client IPs, adding rate-limit filters, and adjusting alert windows. For 429s we usually: 1) exclude from the primary "HighGateway5xx" alert, or 2) create a separate alert for client-error-rate.

infra-bot: Alert HighGateway5xx triggered (edge-proxy) — 1763012358 — current rate 0.9% over 5m threshold 0.5% — alert page: https://alerts.redwood.com/alerts/HighGateway5xx/1763012358

sam: If the alert is mostly 429s, change the alert expression to only consider 5xx: e.g. 
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="prod",status=~"5..",job=~"gateway.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{env="prod",job=~"gateway.*"}[5m]))) * 100 > 0.5
```
This keeps the service-level error alert focused on server errors.

lucy: Also consider increasing the evaluation window to 10m or using a >= on number of failing requests, not just ratio, to reduce noise from small traffic bursts.

maria: Good call — i'll mute the current alert incident and open a PR to: 1) narrow the HighGateway5xx to 5xx only, 2) add a separate HighClient4xx alert with higher threshold and cluster-wide deduping, and 3) add a filter to ignore well-known client IP ranges.

aj: ping me on the PR. For dashboards: check panel "gateway: timeout count (5m)" and the trace link (Tempo) on the right-hand side. If you see timeouts tied to backend latency, correlate with upstream latency panel.

maria: Found some related traces — looks like edge-proxy had intermittent 504s to auth-service. I'll share a couple trace ids in the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: If it's auth-service, also check pod restarts on the Dedicated pool and any recent deploys (CI deploy bot message around 09:10).

maria: Will do. Leaving notes in the incident channel and the PR. Appreciate the quick pointers. :eyes:
